We present to you a unique Cuban blend , crafted in the same way as a premium cigar mix — using cigar leaves: Ligero, Viso, two types of Seco , and a wrapper leaf. It offers a smooth medium strength with notes of creamy caramel, milk chocolate, and hints of nuts . A perfect pairing with single malt whisky or bourbon .
